bio: Since 2014, this shop has been serving authentic Indian fare from all over the country. Its namesake signature biriyani is a must-try - pair with kongu nadu kozhi fry, or spicy dry-fried chicken with grated coconut, a Southern Indian speciality rich in tangy flavours. Also check the blackboard at the door for daily specials. Round off with house-made sweets or masala tea. Certain items are only served after 4 pm....
